meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
₹3000 ke andar **running shoes** ke liye, aapko *daily running + comfort + durability* ke hisaab se ye options dekhne chahiye: **Nike Run Defy**, **Skechers Go Run Consistent**, aur **Puma Voltaic Evo**. Inme se **Nike Run Defy** ko overall best pick bataya gaya hai, jabki **Puma Voltaic Evo** ko running performance ke liye stronger option aur **Skechers Go Run Consistent** ko cushioning ke liye best माना गया है.[1][10]

Agar main simple recommendation doon, to:

- **Best overall:** **Nike Run Defy** — lightweight daily trainer, around **281g**, soft foam cushioning ke saath.[1][10]
- **Best cushioning:** **Skechers Go Run Consistent** — ultra-light foam aur heel-strike support ke liye achha option.[1]
- **Best running-focused:** **Puma Voltaic Evo** — mainly running ke liye better pick mana gaya hai.[10]
- **Budget lower side:** **Campus STRUT** — around **₹1,269**, agar aap beginner ho ya lower budget chahte ho.[10]
- **Value pick under ₹2,700:** **Adidas Vacfast M** ko highest rating aur low price ke saath value option bataya gaya hai.[1]

Aapke liye best choice *use-case* par depend karegi:

- **3–5 km daily runs**: **Nike Run Defy** ya **Skechers Go Run Consistent**[1][2]
- **Sirf running, thoda better performance**: **Puma Voltaic Evo**[10]
- **Beginner ho aur budget tight hai**: **Campus STRUT**[10]
- **Agar discount mile to ASICS / Adidas / Nike / Puma / Skechers ki entry-level models** bhi consider kar sakte ho, kyunki under-3000 lists me ye brands common hain.[2][6][10][12]

Meri practical advice: agar aapko *ek hi pair* lena hai aur confusion avoid karna hai, to **Nike Run Defy** lo; agar wo out of stock mile, to **Skechers Go Run Consistent** second choice rakho.[1][10]

Agar chaho, main aapke liye **men/women**, **daily running distance**, aur **foot type** ke hisaab se 3 exact models shortlist kar doon.
